description: Erection of a 2-storey roof extension containing 3no. residential units and associated amenity; additional cycle parking and refuse storage at 18 Shore Road, E9 7TA.
subdivision_of_building:
Roof Extension. Removal of mezzanine and addition of 2no. storeys. 

Please refer to supporting Planning Statement and DAS (Integrated Planning Document) for further detail.
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, full details must be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority to demonstrate at least the consented standards have been met, as set out in the hereby approved Energy Statement (Revision 02 by Eight Versa dated 12/12/2024)</p><p>Solar PV panels annual electricity peak generation of 2.08 kWp</p><p>Installation certificate by MCS register installer</p><p>As built roof plan (1:50) showing PV array, maintenance and access paths, other plants and services, landscaping including fire breaks where applicable</p><p>Final Operation &amp; Maintenance manual including fire risk assessment where applicable the development hereby approved shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thereby approved.</p><p>Where compliance is not met, a remedial plan and associated cost plan must be prepared and submitted to the Local Authority for approval detailing the necessary measures to meet or improve upon the ‘as designed’ performance. Shortfalls may attract an additional financial contribution to the carbon offset fund.</p><p>REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction, in accordance with LP55 of the Hackney Local Plan, and Section 14 of the National Planning Policy Framework</p><div><br></div>

<p>Prior to the commencement of above-ground works, detailed drawings and specifications of all proposed new and replacement windows, including frame depths, profiles, materials, and finishes, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved details.</p><p>Reason: To ensure an appropriate relationship with the existing building and to secure high-quality detailing in accordance with Policy LP1 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020)</p>

font-family: &quot;Arial &quot;; font-size: 12pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:'Arial ';color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details:</span></p><p></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:'Arial ';color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.&nbsp;</span></p><div><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:'Arial ';color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"><br></span></div>

<p>Prior to the installation of the air source heat pump (ASHP), full details of the proposed enclosure and any associated acoustic or visual screening shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The ASHP shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</p><p>Reason: To ensure that the equipment is appropriately designed and screened in the interests of visual amenity and to mitigate noise and visual impacts, in accordance with Policies LP1 and LP16 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development, a waste and recycling management strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The strategy shall include details of collection arrangements, the design and location of bin stores, and access arrangements. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved strategy and maintained thereafter.</p><p>Reason: To ensure adequate waste and recycling facilities are provided and to avoid visual clutter and obstruction, in accordance with Policy LP17 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</p>

<p>No development shall take place until a Construction Management Plan (CMP) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The CMP shall include details of construction traffic management, dust suppression, noise mitigation, hours of working, and waste disposal arrangements. The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved CMP.</p><p>Reason: To protect the amenity of neighbouring occupiers and ensure highway safety during construction, in accordance with Policies LP16 and LP42 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</p>

<p>The rating level of noise emitted from plant and machinery at the site shall be at least 5dB(A) below the background noise level (LA90) at the nearest noise-sensitive receptor, as measured and assessed in accordance with BS4142:2014+A1:2019 (or any subsequent updated standard). A verification report demonstrating compliance shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority within three months of installation.</p><p>Reason: To safeguard the amenity of nearby occupiers by ensuring noise levels remain acceptable, in accordance with Policy LP16 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</p>
